p1.text: Bo pushed on his gate. It swung open wide. The whole farm was waiting!

a.text: A duck sat by the pond. She had a row of ducklings. They all quacked at Bo.

b.text: The barn smelled like warm hay. A tiny kitten blinked at him. Then it climbed the hay.

c.text: The field was full of flowers. A fat bee buzzed past. Bo sneezed a big sneeze.

a2.text: The ducklings swam in a line. Bo dipped in one hoof. The water was very cold!

b2.text: The kitten came to say hi. It sat down in the hay. Bo held very still.

c2.text: Bo followed the buzzy bee. It landed on a red flower. More bees came to look.

a2x.text: Bo jumped in with a splash. The ducklings splashed him back. Everyone got very wet.

a2y.text: They looked down in the water. One little fish swam by. It waved its tail hello.

a2z.text: The duck showed Bo her nest. It was soft and warm. One egg wiggled a little!

b2x.text: They walked all around the barn. The kitten stayed right beside him. It purred the whole time.

b2y.text: They jumped in the soft hay. Hay flew up in the air. Bo had hay on his nose.

b2z.text: Bo found the milk bowl. The kitten drank it all up. Bo chewed a carrot instead.

c2x.text: Bo picked one yellow flower. He held it in his teeth. It tickled his nose.

c2y.text: The bee flew to its hive. Bo watched from far away. The hive hummed a song.

c2z.text: A blue butterfly floated by. Bo chased it through the grass. It danced right past his nose.
